label: IDF Drone Strike — Damascus Outskirts (Apr 30, 2026)
notes: IDF drone strike on armed group allegedly preparing to attack Druze community in Suwayda; operation followed lobbying by Israeli Druze leader Mowafaq Tarif

label: IDF Airstrike — Near Damascus Presidential Palace (May 2, 2026)
damage: Military sites hit; one killed in Harasta suburb
notes: Part of 20+ Israeli strikes across Syria on May 2; struck near presidential compound in Damascus and military sites in Harasta suburb

label: IDF Artillery — Quneitra Countryside (May 2, 2026)
notes: Israeli artillery shelling targeting Syrian military positions in Quneitra; IDF warned Syrian military to halt operations against Druze community

label: IDF Airstrike — Latakia (May 2, 2026)
notes: Part of coordinated May 2 Israeli strike package; targeted military infrastructure near Latakia

label: IDF Airstrike — Hama (May 2, 2026)
notes: Part of coordinated May 2 Israeli strike package; four civilians injured in Hama governorate

label: IDF Airstrike — Daraa (May 2, 2026)
notes: Part of coordinated May 2 Israeli strike package targeting Syrian military sites in Daraa governorate

label: IDF Artillery — Taranja/Quneitra Agricultural Land (May 16, 2026)
notes: Part of Israeli incursions into Quneitra villages on May 16; artillery shells hit agricultural land near Taranja, no casualties. Israeli forces also entered Saida al-Hanout and established checkpoint near Jubata al-Khashab.

label: IDF Airstrike — Latakia Anti-Ship Missile Depots (May 30, 2026)
damage: Anti-ship missile storage and SAM components destroyed; one civilian killed near Zama/Jableh
casualties: 1 killed, 3 injured (civilian, near Zama village, Jableh District)
notes: IDF confirmed targeting anti-ship missile storage facilities and surface-to-air missile components near Latakia. SANA confirmed strikes and civilian casualties. First significant Israeli strike in Syria in several weeks. Transitional government protested as sovereignty violation.

label: IDF Airstrike — Tartus Military Sites (May 30, 2026)
notes: Part of coordinated May 30 Israeli strike package alongside Latakia anti-ship missile depot strikes. SOHR confirmed military sites near Tartus were hit. Tartus hosts Russia's only Mediterranean naval facility.

label: US CENTCOM Drone Strike — ISIS Leader al-Ulaywi, Idlib Countryside (Jun 19, 2026)
notes: CENTCOM announced June 24 that a drone strike on June 19 killed senior ISIS leader Ali Husayn al-Ulaywi in Idlib province countryside; SOHR corroborated, reporting a motorcycle-riding target destroyed by a precision strike. First major US counter-ISIS strike announced since the US completed its full military withdrawal from Syria in April 2026.

label: IDF Incursion & Shelling — Abidin Village, Yarmouk Basin (Jun 29, 2026)
damage: Artillery shells and illumination flares fired near residential areas; no structural damage reported
notes: Israeli forces advanced into Abidin village in the Yarmouk Basin (western Deraa), fired artillery shells and illumination flares near homes overnight, prompting families to flee to nearby villages; forces withdrew by Monday morning. Separately, IDF said troops in southern Syria came under fire and retaliated with a helicopter strike. Syrian Sijil Center recorded ~300 Israeli operations/violations in Deraa and Quneitra during June 2026, including 107 incursions and raids.

label: IDF Airstrikes — Abu al-Duhur Airbase, Idlib (Aug 18, 2026)
damage: Runway and hangar/storage facilities under refurbishment hit; no casualties
notes: Eight strikes on the disused Abu al-Duhur airbase in eastern Idlib; Israel said the strikes were preventive against Turkish plans to deploy air-defense systems and drones at the base, sparking friction with Turkey and the US.

label: IDF Drone Strike — Truck Near Beit Jinn (Aug 22, 2026)
damage: Civilian truck struck on road near Beit Jinn
notes: IDF said it targeted an operative in the final stages of preparing an attack on Israeli forces in southern Syria; Syria's Foreign Ministry condemned the strike on what it called a civilian vehicle as a sovereignty violation.
